items.heading: These Two Job Titles Get
items.text: These two job titles get typed into search bars almost interchangeably, but they are not the same career, the same skill bet, or the same certification path.

items.heading: Strip Away the Job
items.text: Strip away the job-title variation across industries, and the core job repeats almost everywhere: define the scope, build a realistic schedule and budget, assign and track work across people who often do not report to you, flag risk before it becomes a missed deadline, and keep every stakeholder aligned on what "done" actually means. The glamorous part of the title is the plan; the real daily work is closer to persistent, structured follow-through.

figures.label: But Number Most Candidates Should
figures.source: PMI charges a lower exam fee to its own members than to non-members, but the number most candidates should budget for is the realistic all-in total: exam fee, PMI membership, an approved 35-hour training course, and study material, plus GST. For most candidates in India, that realistic total lands somewhere between roughly Rs 55,000 and Rs 1,00,000, depending on the training provider and whether you join PMI as a member to unlock the discounted exam fee.
